newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends One Holding.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends One Holding.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Wednesday suspended One Holding Plc after it halted trading in the shares on Tuesday afternoon.

The bourse did not clarify its decision, which followed One Holding's announcement that it could not honour repayment on two maturing bills of exchange worth a combined $13.5 million on Monday and Tuesday.
One Holding said in a statement its financial advisors were negotiating with creditors on restructuring the debt.
